source.title: Call for Applicants - WFC Members (July 2019)
source.content:
The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) is looking for two or three new members to add to its team. The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WFC do?
- Determine the annual budget for the WCA including analysis and projections of competitor counts.
- Manage the dues system including invoicing and credit control.
- Complete tax and other regulatory compliance forms on behalf of the WCA.
- Manage the finances and cash flow of the WCA.
- Review applications for funding in accordance with the Equipment Funding and Travel Reimbursement policies.
- Other financial tasks requested by the WCA Board or in accordance with our Motions.

The official rights and duties of the WFC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2017.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.3%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf).

Please submit your application **by Sunday, July 28th, 2019 at 23:59 UTC to the WCA Treasurer and Leader of the WCA Financial Committee, Chris Wright (cwright@worldcubeassociation.org)**. Applications will be reviewed by the WFC leadership team.
<!-- break --> 
The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:
- Experience in finance, tax or accounting.
- Good math or data analytics skills.
- Good written English.
- Time commitment of 2-5 hours per week.
- Prompt review and response to committee emails.

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WFC members to have additional experience with any of the following:
- Experience using spreadsheets.
- Familiarity with Google G-Suite.
- Knowledge and experience in non-profit or corporate finances.
- US tax and IRS knowledge.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:
- A brief personal introduction.
- Your WCA resume listing your involvement with the cubing community.
- Your professional resume (especially if math/accounting/finance related).
- Your motivation for applying to the WFC.
- Your ambitions for what you plan to contribute to the WFC as a committee member to further the WCA.

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WFC Leader.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate in reaching out to Chris Wright (cwright@worldcubeassociation.org) or the WFC Deputy Leader, James Molloy (jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 财务委员会成员招募（2019 年 7 月）
translation.content:
WCA 财务委员会（WFC）希望招募两至三名新成员。申请向所有人开放，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

WFC 的工作是什么？

- 制定 WCA 年度预算，包括分析和预测参赛人数。
- 管理会费制度，包括开具账单及跟进欠款。
- 代表 WCA 填报税务及其他监管合规文件。
- 管理 WCA 的财务和现金流。
- 按照器材资助及差旅报销政策审核资助申请。
- 完成 WCA 董事会要求或各项动议规定的其他财务工作。

WFC 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 动议 10.2017.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2017.3%20-%20Financial%20Committee.pdf)。

请于 **2019 年 7 月 28 日（星期日）23:59 UTC 前，将申请发送给 WCA 财务主管兼财务委员会负责人 Chris Wright（cwright@worldcubeassociation.org）**。申请将由 WFC 管理团队审阅。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

- 有财务、税务或会计经验。
- 良好的数学或数据分析能力。
- 良好的英语书面表达能力。
- 每周能投入 2 至 5 小时。
- 能及时查看和回复委员会邮件。

以下并非必需条件，但如有相关经验，将对工作有所帮助：

- 有使用电子表格的经验。
- 熟悉 Google G-Suite。
- 了解非营利组织或企业财务，并有相关经验。
- 了解美国税务及美国国税局（IRS）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 列明参与魔方社区经历的 WCA 履历。
- 职业履历，尤其是与数学、会计或财务有关的经历。
- 申请加入 WFC 的原因。
- 计划以委员会成员身份为 WFC 作出哪些贡献，帮助 WCA 发展。

我们会及时回复，确认申请材料是否齐全；你也可能获邀参加 WFC 负责人的面试。

如有疑问，请随时联系 Chris Wright（cwright@worldcubeassociation.org）或 WFC 副负责人 James Molloy（jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
